cyberware.name: Encephalon
cyberware.notes: This can be taken by AIs. The wireless bonus represents the effects of the Encephalon while in VR.

cyberware.name: Speed Booster
cyberware.notes: Running and Sprinting no longer take actions and do not penalize attacks. The first use of Dodge or RFYL in a combat turn does not cost Initiative.

cyberware.name: Grey Mana Dermal Plating
cyberware.notes: Grey Mana Dermal Plating's rating and grade must match your Dermal Plating rating and grade.

cyberware.name: Grey Mana Bone Lacing
cyberware.notes: Subtracts 1 hit from any Health, mana-based Illusion, or mental Manipulation spells that affect the character. Bare-handed unarmed attacks ignore ItNW. Must be of identical grade to the character's Bone Lacing.

cyberware.name: Simsense Interface Overdrive
cyberware.notes: This cyberware only functions while in VR.

cyberware.name: Tentacle Modification
cyberware.notes: Subudal attacks gain +1 DV and -2 AP per tentacle.

cyberware.name: Articulated Weapons Mount
cyberware.notes: Can hold a single weapon of up to Assault Rifle size. Uses Torso Agility + (Autosoft or Activesoft Rating) to attack.

cyberware.name: Eye Laser System
cyberware.notes: Acts as a laser rangefinder and laser microphone. Can be used to transmit to other eye laser systems via eye contact. Can blind targets using the DEW skill.

cyberware.name: Smartlink (Throwback)
cyberware.notes: Provides the Smartlink wireless bonus of +2 dice even when wireless off. Base Essence cost is 0.5, -0.1 Essence for each of the following: Simrig, Image Link, and Induction Pad or Skinlink Echo.

cyberware.name: Smartlink-2 Upgrade
cyberware.notes: Halves called shot penalties (does not stack with Sharpshooter/Strive for Perfection). -1 Threshold for grenade/rocket attacks. Must be of the same grade as the Throwback Smartlink.

cyberware.name: Bone Lacing (Kevlar)
cyberware.notes: Kevlar Bone Lacing does not show up on cyberware scanners.

cyberware.name: Bone Lacing (Ceramic)
cyberware.notes: Ceramic Bone Lacing does not show up on cyberware scanners.

cyberware.name: Smartlink Induction Pad
cyberware.notes: At least one is required to use the Throwback Smartlink. The Throwback Smartlink comes with one by default. Installing the default induction pad into a cyberlimb reduces the smartlink essence cost by 0.1.

cyberware.name: Surface Toner
cyberware.notes: Only covers the cyberlimb which it is installed. In other words, one is needed for each installed cyberlimb. Compatible with Skin Toner (which only applies to natural skin) and is a requirement for Chameleon Processor to have an effect.

cyberware.name: Integrity Enhancement
cyberware.notes: Adds +Rating damage resistance against called shots which target the limb. Torso/Head Integrity Enhancement applies against CS: Vitals as well.

cyberware.name: Move-by-Wire System (Throwback)
cyberware.notes:
Uses (Rating + 2) Monthly Focus points for medical care. If the character lacks enough focus points, it costs 10,000 nuyen per missing point per month.
Taking (4-Rating) or more boxes of physical damage in a stressful situation requires a WIL test, threshold (Rating * 2). Failure causes seizures.
Seizures deal 3P + 3S damage. Both are resisted by Body only. R4+ Throwback MBW will immediately cause the character to go into seizures.
At the end of each run, make a WIL test, threshold (Rating * 2). Failure means the character gains the TLE-X negative quality.
Overrides all other initiative and reaction enhancements which do not explicitly stack with other init/reaction enhancements.

cyberware.name: Synthetic Features
cyberware.notes: Rating 1 is synthetic, Rating 2-5 are equivalent of R-1 improved Synthskin

cyberware.name: Component Miniaturization (Full Arm/Full Leg, Torso, Chassis)
